features.label: Genuine manufacturer compatibility
features.text: Engineered specifically for the Ossur CTi3 Knee Brace to guarantee a flawless fit that restores the original structural integrity and clinical support of your device

features.label: Enhanced hygiene and skin health
features.text: Swap out old, compressed, and sweat-soaked padding with fresh, breathable medical-grade foam liners to significantly reduce skin friction, prevent bacterial buildup, and eliminate painful pressure points during extended wear

features.label: Unyielding adhesive security
features.text: The specialized Hook Sets utilize advanced, high-strength adhesive technology to firmly anchor your new liners to the rigid carbon frame, effectively preventing the brace from slipping or migrating down your leg during intense physical activity

features.label: High impact shielding
features.text: Upgrade your baseline brace with purpose-built MX Kits and Impact Guards designed to absorb and deflect severe direct blows, keeping your vulnerable kneecap and healing ligaments safe during extreme sports or rugged outdoor work

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our US-based brace specialists to ensure your new components are installed correctly for personalized support

measurement: Choose your replacement parts based on the side (Left or Right) and the size (S, M, L, XL, or combined sizes like S-M and L-XL) of your existing Ossur CTi3 Knee Brace. Note: Brace is not included. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for more details.
